{{Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''PT Krakatau Posco Energy power station''' is an operating power station of at least 200-megawatts (MW) in Samangraya, Citangkil, Cilegon, Jawa, Indonesia.

==Background==

PT Krakatau Posco Energy power station (2 x 100 MW) began operating in 2014.<ref>[https://www.krakatauposcoenergy.com/company-history.php Company History], PT Krakatau Posco Energy, accessed April 8, 2026</ref> The coal-fired units were built to support the industrial activites of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk.<ref>[https://chandra-asri.com/en/our-business/energy Eco-friendly Electricity and Renewable Electricity Provider], Chandra Asri Group, accessed April 8, 2026</ref>

As of March 2026, the 200 MW captive plant was still operating.<ref>[https://chandradaya-investasi.com/en/media/blog/sustainable-energy What Is Sustainable Energy? Learn About Its Many Benefits!], Chandra Daya Investasi, March 18, 2026</ref>
